result.markdown: --- title: "[Graph.select_edges_by_node()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method}" body-classes: doc-api-page page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} Select all edges connected to specified nodes. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/blob/main/python/edgecase/graph.py#L5674-L5741){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python Graph.select_edges_by_node(nodes) ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} Selects all edges where at least one endpoint is in the provided node list. For directed graphs, includes both incoming and outgoing edges. Useful for selecting the local connectivity around specific nodes. ::: ## Parameters {.doc-parameters} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [nodes]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [list[int | str]]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : List of node IDs (int) or labels (str) whose incident edges should be selected. ::: ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [Graph]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : Self for method chaining. ::: ## Examples {.doc-examples} Select edges incident to a specific node using node ID: ::: {#51f20835 .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import edgecase as ec graph = ( ec.Graph() .add_node(label="A") .add_node(label="B") .add_node(label="C") .add_node(label="D") .add_edge(source="A", target="B") .add_edge(source="B", target="C") .add_edge(source="C", target="D") ) b_id = graph.get_id_from_label("B") graph.select_edges_by_node([b_id]) # Selects A-B and B-C edges selected = graph.count_selected_edges() # Returns 2 selected ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ``` 2 ``` ::: ::: Can also use labels directly: ::: {#a91e51ff .cell execution_count=2} ``` {.python .cell-code} graph = ( ec.Graph() .add_node(label="A") .add_node(label="B") .add_node(label="C") .add_node(label="D") .add_edge(source="A", target="B") .add_edge(source="B", target="C") .add_edge(source="C", target="D") ) graph.select_edges_by_node(["B"]) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=2} ``` Number of nodes : 4 Number of edges : 3 Directed : False Density : 0.50 Average degree (min, max) : 1.50 (1, 2) Connected : True Number of connected components : 1 Tree : True Bipartite : True ``` ::: :::
